steps.content: Just like Bass, the worn-out ball sits there motionlessly, repeating the same incomprehensible conversation over and over.
Underneath its childish, innocuous appearance, it speaks with a very old and kind voice.

steps.speaker: Ball
steps.content: There... are so many people... Let me see, oh, how come... I don't recognize anyone...

steps.speaker: Ball
steps.content: My memory is getting worse... Are you all here to keep Eve company?

steps.speaker: Ball
steps.content: Good, our little Eve has made some friends out there too, hasn't she...

steps.speaker: Ball
steps.content: She's still young... She should have someone with her...

steps.speaker: Ball
steps.content: Shanna is still young... still so young... I should go back and be with her...
As the ball speaks, its tone is full of warm affection. When it finishes, it closes its eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this also one of Eve's family members?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Yes, you're really lucky! I knew I chose the right person!
Oliver playfully picks up the ball from the ground, knocking it against the screaming chicken.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've proven that I can beat these toys. Can you tell me now? How are we going to work together?
After another battle, your physical condition is getting worse, but you try hard to endure it, determined not to lose your bravado in front of this kid.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: It's simple, wreak the biggest havoc you can! Destroy everything Eve values the most!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So that Eve can focus on dealing with me, and you'll have a chance to escape?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Exactly. Oliver will get out and find some powerful adults to rescue you and your friend. Sounds like a perfect plan?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What if you simply leave and forget about me?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oh well, in that case, you'll just have to... fend for yourself.
Of course you can't trust this little brat!
And you noticed there's an obvious contradiction in this...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're saying destroying Eve's family will enrage her, but it was also you who said that Eve is a freak who'd turn even her own family into toys...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Aren't these two things contradictory?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Are you doubting Oliver? But... everything Oliver said is true... Is it because Oliver has been alone and without family since childhood that I can't understand their twisted pleasure?

Tears well up in Oliver's eyes and those hands tighten around you, choking your questions in your throat. This kid can't give you any more clues. You shift your gaze back to Bass and this ball in front of you...

Oliver does indeed want to escape, and you want to find Pepper and make her human again... But strangely enough, you don't feel any resentment from the screaming chicken and the ball for having been turned into toys, only utter kindness and good wishes toward Eve.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Were these toy family members truly forced to be part of this twisted game of house against their will?
Or is there a set of goals and rules in this factory that neither you nor Oliver understands? Why exactly is Eve doing this...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oh, don't get hung up on family and whatnot. Oliver doesn't understand these things. All I know is that you've run into two special toys in a row, and Eve must be very, very angry right now!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Our plan is about to succeed... Argh!!!
Before you can see what happened, Oliver has been suddenly struck by an inexplicable force, crashing into a steel pipe in the distance, making a huge noise.
From the depths of the endless corridor, a faint, bone-chilling murmur creeps into your ears.
Guests are not welcome here...
As if out of a toy's instinctive fear of its owner, you feel the fabric all over your body tense involuntarily.
If you can quietly fit into this place, I can pretend you don't exist.
But today is Bone's birthday, it'll be complicated if Bass and Benna are absent.
As the dust gradually settles, the sound of metal wheels rolling over rough concrete nears. Finally, those doll-like ball-jointed legs come into view.
You look up and see a pale girl in a wheelchair. Her gaze is downcast, staring at the screaming chicken and ball defeated by you on the ground.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eve.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I can't bend over. Do you mind picking up these two toys? They're my very important family.
She is indeed talking to you, but she doesn't look at you once.
The corridor is exceptionally quiet, all sounds seemingly swallowed by the darkness behind Eve.
Even the noise of Oliver scrambling up from the ground behind you is amplified infinitely in this silence.
You pat your recently squashed body, take two steps forward, and pick up the two toys with your cotton palms.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They're important to you? What a coincidence, you also hold something very important to me.
There's no response, but thankfully she doesn't seem infuriated either. You don't sense any obvious hostility. She simply waits for you to bring her the two toys silently.
Holding up a screaming chicken and a ball at the same time is no easy task for a rag doll like you, but you still take the risk and begin negotiating while dragging them behind you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My body, and my friend's body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll give you back your family, and in exchange, you'll give those back to me.
Eve doesn't respond for a long time. The light in the corridor is too dim, or are you imagining it? Her gaze seems to linger on you for a moment at last.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You and your friend entered my factory and then became toys.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To be precise, my friend got turned into a toy by you first. I only came to bring her back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We tried leaving through other exits, but Oliver said it wouldn't work. Only you can change us back.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I can't.
She responds coldly without looking at you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How can that be? You transformed us, you must be able to undo it.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I... can't.
She repeats stiffly.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I've warned everyone to stay away. This is my home, I own it.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: How is it my fault when they insisted on barging in...
She lowers her head, her voice a bit muffled, like she's just murmuring to herself.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I don't know how to change you back. I'm just a useless child who's seen as a burden.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It took me a long time to come this far, to make this factory feel like home.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But outsiders like you insist on barging in. And now you even want to take my family away from me, and you even dare to...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Threaten me?
A familiar power gathers all of a sudden, powerful, overwhelming Mania filling every bit of air in the factory...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I apologize. I didn't mean any harm. Calm down, we can talk it out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not trying to threaten you or snoop around. I only came to save my frie... Cough, cough!
The abrupt pressure triggers an involuntary resistance in you. But attacked by the defensive urge and the terrifying force from within and without, you begin coughing and dry heaving.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: She's speeding up the toyification of everything in Buonanotte! ...Get out of here now, you stupid doll!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Stop wasting your time. If she could be persuaded, I wouldn't need your help!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is the toyification... Pepper has told me about... Cough, cough!
Covering your mouth and nose, you catch what you cough up from your body. A clump of blood-stained cotton!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Are you shocked? But that friend of yours has been going through this all along.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: If she really means that much to you, how could you lose her?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Shouldn't you cherish your important ones and keep them by your side?
The girl in the wheelchair looks confusedly in an unknown direction, propping up her body feebly.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: He's right... You're all foolish, indifferent, and arrogant intruders.

steps.speaker: Scavenger
steps.content: Do the lives of intruders matter?

steps.speaker: Scavenger
steps.content: As you're going through all of this, does anyone else care? They'll just keep tearing up your wounds to satisfy themselves. But then, who's going to fulfill your tiny wish?
It's only natural that a toy factory is filled with toys...
Then you'll all turn into toys, even if it'll cost you your life!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: All of you will... turn into toys!
Suddenly, Eve turns to you, her pupils seemed to glow with a faintly frightening light. A single glance makes you feel like you're tumbling into an icy cellar.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Watch out!!
As Oliver cries out, the visible Mania miasma gathers around Eve.
Out of combative instinct, you reach and grasp the closest and biggest weakness of the enemy.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Hey... Don't touch Eve's prosthetic. She'll get mad!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I've already touched it.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Just die...
Eve's fingers have almost etched into the wheelchair. As her breathing quickens, the force pressing on you also intensifies.

As if falling into deep water, you can't breathe or make a sound for almost a whole minute. You seem to sense in that filthy power a determination to obliterate everything at the cost of self-destruction!
Eve's face is getting paler, her body weaker, but you can't take advantage of it at all. The cotton inside your body starts churning violently, ready to explode if you so much as breathe.
Pepper is nowhere to be found. You can't just give up here like this... There's no other way...
In an instant, crimson light collides with the surging black fume, exploding with a massive blast of energy.
Your senses are overwhelmed by the white light and the ringing in your ears...
Benna, do you think he can get Eve out?
steps.female_content: Benna, do you think she can get Eve out?

steps.content: I don't know... but he's a good kid. Eve was too hard on him.
steps.female_content: I don't know... but she's a good kid. Eve was too hard on her.

steps.content: Poor Eve! She's straining herself! Bass don't want Eve suffer anymore!
It was so hard to take him away under Eve's watch. Let him see that!
steps.female_content: It was so hard to take her away under Eve's watch. Let her see that!

steps.content: See... what?
How could you forget again, Benna, you dummy! Our story with Eve, of course!
Oh, that's right. My memory does worsen day by day...
Right, right, show him. He will surely understand.
steps.female_content: Right, right, show her. She will surely understand.

steps.content: This person can surely... get Eve out.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: But will Eve be upset if she finds out?
She won't blame us.
Eve is a good girl, just like my granddaughter Shanna. This... I will never forget.
